title: Page 165
transc:
Ft Monroe May 28 . 1864 
Maj Eckert Di
for princess Allen a vinton growl unity the pay
monkey is navy gable for vessels of plaster to
person and half feet draft zodiac as far up
as new Castle youth as Kimball pilgrim a vincent
Geo D Sheldon


Washington May 28  1864
Geo D Sheldon
Ivory opinion is that the Gloucester route is the best
plunge prolong spit can saddle that line where a whip
could not the other pause unless u know of some
very good reason why it should not be Dunn let
the work be commenced first Peru Mackintosh arrives with his
party & push through fast as Can send Logue &
Embree to Jamestown and hold blissfull & Glazier ready for
white house send Collings to Haven & Homan to Gloucester
if office is needed there zodiac Bickford has some operators
with him who will be stationed at homer send Cowans
with Mackintoshs building party let him come in circuit twice
a day & white progress and inform me all blank
T. T. Eckert


Ft Monroe May 28 . 1864
R OBrien Hd Qrs Genl Butler
for Knox unity since sending my despatch Ivory has given
his opinion that the torrent side of York Windsor is
best route as it can be saddled by small force
Geo D Sheldon
